conviction_note: A slight positive lean only: Q3 NAV is likely to rise because Swedish 5y yields went up about 70bp (gains on 21.8bn of pay-fixed swaps) and the one Stockholm peer that has reported Q3 left its valuation yields unchanged. Against that, income from property management (the line this stock trades on) has no sourced bar and was flat to down y/y in H1, and that peer fell 4.5% on a report with unchanged yields. So p_up is 53 on an abs move of 3.2, giving +0.19 against an impact_sum of +0.50. The gap is there because the findings are mostly NAV and below-the-line items, which this stock and its peer have not been rewarded for.

findings.finding: Swedish 5y government yields rose from 2.32% (30 Jun) to 3.03% (30 Sep) and 10y from 2.67% to 3.24%. Wallenstam pays fixed on 21.8 Mdr of swaps, and Q2's roughly 28bp fall in the 5y produced −414 Mkr, so Q3 should carry a derivative gain of roughly +500 to +1,000 Mkr, about +0.6 to +1.2 kr/share of NAV after tax (substansvärde includes derivatives).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 carried −413 Mkr of derivatives and the stock rose 1.4% on report day (6 Jul); Q1'26's report day was −4.15%. Derivative swings have not visibly driven report-day moves; the stock trades on income from property management.
findings.original_quote: Totala volymen utestående räntederivat, där Wallenstam betalar fast ränta, uppgår till 21,8 Mdr (22,1). ... Räntederivatens värde har utvecklats negativt under perioden, -414 Mkr (-529), till följd av lägre långräntor. [Q2 report, https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aa79f013a22ebfa24f37c9f6600966f2e] (Total pay-fixed swap volume 21.8bn; derivatives fell 414 Mkr in Q2 on lower long rates.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: any analyst with a swap model has it. What is not priced is the size: the stock fell 13.4% over 60 days while this rate rise mechanically ADDED to NAV, so the market is reading the rate move only through future yields. If it were fully priced, the NAV discount would not have widened alongside a rising book NAV.
findings.independence: The same rate move hit Atrium Ljungberg's derivatives: +113 Mkr unrealised in Q3 (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a2abca193edae7b3e8d48c8a8a02e8948)

findings.finding: The one Stockholm property company to have reported Q3 2026, Atrium Ljungberg (9 Oct), left its average valuation yield unchanged and reported +0.2% value change in the quarter despite the sharp rise in long rates. That makes a yield increase, and the NAV writedown the market fears for Wallenstam (+0.25pp yield = about −4.0 Mdr), less likely in this report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Wallenstam has made no yield changes for several quarters and value changes have been positive (Q2 +376 Mkr, stock +1.4%). The peer test cuts both ways: Atrium Ljungberg fell 4.5% on 9 Oct with unchanged yields (its property-management income fell to 328 Mkr from 352), so unchanged yields alone did not lift a peer.
findings.why_not_priced: The sector traded off on rates through Q3 (Wallenstam −13.4% over 60 days, Fabege −12.9%, Wihlborgs −10.8%), and DNB Carnegie cut its target to 34 kr with a sell rating on 30 Sep. That is a market positioned for valuation pressure. One peer's unchanged yields is not a sector read, and Wallenstam fell only 0.9% on the AL day.
findings.independence: Wallenstam's own Q2 report: no yield changes, 'Det har inte skett förändringar i fastigheternas direktavkastningskrav' (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aa79f013a22ebfa24f37c9f6600966f2e)

findings.finding: The wind parks were sold at a value of 830 Mkr against a 703 Mkr book value at 30 June and handed over on 1 July, so Q3 should book a one-off disposal gain of up to about 125 Mkr (about 0.2 kr/share), outside income from property management.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior disposal of this size to compare; property sales gains have not shown up as report-day moves.
findings.original_quote: Försäljningen sker genom bolag, där vindkraftverken har ett värde om 830 Mkr. (The sale is made through companies, where the wind turbines carry a value of 830 Mkr.) / Q2 report: 'Koncernens bokförda värde för vindkraftverk uppgick på bokslutsdagen till 703 Mkr (746).'
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: both numbers are public and computable. It is a one-off with no path to income from property management, and the perimeter (company values, transaction costs) may cut the gain. Filed small because the exact gain is not yet disclosed.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Buybacks have run since 2025 without visible report-day effect.
findings.original_quote: Efter indragningen innehar Wallenstam per dagens datum 4 010 000 egna B-aktier, köpta till en genomsnittskurs om 41,19 kronor per aktie inklusive courtage. (After the cancellation Wallenstam holds 4,010,000 own B shares bought at an average 41.19 kr.)
findings.why_not_priced: The August figure is public. Only the September volume is new, and it is small against a 22bn market cap.

findings.finding: Sergelskrapan stays vacant for refurbishment (a 300 Mkr green bond was raised for it on 23 Sep), so Q3 income from property management carries the same drag that cut H1 NOI by 40 Mkr, against a high Q3'25 base of 344 Mkr plus 1.6bn more average debt. A flat-to-down year-on-year print is the likely result.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1'26 income from property management fell 7% y/y (292 vs 314) and the stock fell 4.15% on the day; Q2'26 fell 2% y/y (338 vs 344) and it rose 1.4%.
findings.original_quote: Driftnettot minskar med 17 Mkr, av vilket Sergelskrapan påverkar med -40 Mkr. (Net operating income falls 17 Mkr, of which Sergelskrapan accounts for −40 Mkr.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the drag is disclosed and analysts model it, and it sits inside what the company has told the market. It is filed small because the bar is unsourced and the Q1 reaction shows a y/y decline on this line can move the stock.

baseline_tension: The evidence leans mildly positive (NAV up, yields probably held) against a negative run-up (−7.7% over 20 days, −13.4% over 60) that tracks the sector's rate selloff. The positive priced lean of +0.39 comes from the run-up alone, so the findings agree with it weakly and do not beat it.
language_note: Wallenstam publishes every release in Swedish and English at once on the Nasdaq Nordic feed, and the filings added nothing the English versions do not carry.

The Swedish Q2 report PDF was the readable source for the swap volume, the NAV definition, the Sergelskrapan NOI drag and the Q3 report date ('Delårsrapport Q3, 2026 15 oktober 2026'); the same content is in the English report.
Swedish broker telegrams on Placera (Finwire) carried the only dated sell-side datum: DNB Carnegie cut its target to 34 kr with a sell rating on 30 Sep. No English source carried it.
The FI insider register (Swedish only) showed no PDMR buying into the drawdown since June.
lessons_applied: 'Already told is worth 0': the wind-park gain went from +0.1 to +0.05 (both numbers public), the buyback from +0.1 to +0.05 (August figure public) and the Sergelskrapan drag from −0.2 to −0.1 (disclosed, inside what analysts model).
'A beat made of a one-off is sold': the derivative finding went from +0.3 to +0.2, because it is non-cash and below the line this stock trades on.
Macro-to-company transmission and the peer proxy weigh less in p_up: 54 became 53.

'Size the move on what is new; history moves p_up, not abs': abs_move held at 3.2 (new numbers, no guidance line, so above the 2.3% reiterated/none median and the name's ~1.4% median observed reaction) and was not cut to the history.
